requirements.conclusion: Exact baseline reconciled to source proposal; existing components reused as recorded in package evidence.
Extend `log_match_index.py`/`log_workbench.py` with bounded template extraction and ordered per-rank comparison, retaining original line references.
Require evidence for rank/attempt association; allow role cohorts instead of assuming every rank should match a global majority.

Acceptance: known divergent and legitimate-role fixtures produce an interpretable first divergence and last common anchor; reordered timestamps, missing/rotated/truncated logs, repeated templates, and ties remain explicit.
Do not use timestamp equality as proof of causal ordering.
Bound bytes, templates, ranks, and comparison window; report truncation/approximation.
Compare against a simple normalized diff baseline and preserve a path to raw evidence.

integrated_validation.outcome: Supported Python 3.10–3.14 full regression and 25 packaging/installed/schema/reference checks per interpreter passed locally.
integrated_validation.limits: Optional tool skips, actual supplementary qualifications, experimental milestones and external gates remain distinct. No hosted CI or publication is claimed.
